layer: NASA remote-sensing layer for the farm passport
access: Requests are composed by the skill (scripts/indicator_select.py nasa_request) and executed by a data agent with NASA Earthdata access (or manually via NASA Earthdata / AppEEARS). The skill never downloads on its own.
rules: Satellite results are evidence class 'remote' (a proxy): they target sampling, set triggers and describe context; they never set a status colour alone.
Field-scale products are used for an object only when the pixel-fit check gives at least 9 pure pixels (skill convention).
Farm-context products (SMAP, IMERG, POWER) describe the farm's surroundings; they are never attributed to a single field.
Every value keeps its provenance: product, version, granule or tile, acquisition date, cloud/quality mask.

products.name: Harmonized Landsat Sentinel-2 surface reflectance (L30, S30) v2.0
products.variables: surface reflectance → NDVI, EVI, bare-soil index
products.cadence: observations about every 1.6 days combined, cloud-dependent; archive from 2013
products.limits: clouds; mixed pixels on narrow strips and small ponds

products.name: OPERA Dynamic Surface Water Extent from HLS (DSWx-HLS) v1
products.limits: optical: misses flooding under cloud or dense canopy

products.name: ECOSTRESS land surface temperature and evapotranspiration (ISS)
products.cadence: irregular ISS overpasses, varying time of day
products.limits: irregular revisit; 70 m pixels need large fields

products.name: SMAP L4 surface and root-zone soil moisture (SPL4SMGP V007, NSIDC DAAC)
products.limits: 9 km EASE-Grid 2.0 model–data product, from 2015-03-31: regional anomaly, not a field value; licence not stated on the NASA catalogue page (record it on delivery)

products.name: GPM IMERG precipitation
products.limits: 0.1° grid (about 10 km); use to time event sampling and erosivity

products.name: NASA POWER meteorology (agroclimatology)
products.limits: meteorology on a ½° × ⅝° grid (MERRA-2, from 1981; end trend analyses ~2 months before near real time); solar on 1° × 1° (CERES / GEWEX). An on-farm sensor is preferred for heat stress; POWER is the fallback

products.name: Landsat archive (pre-2013 field history)
products.limits: archive span and processing level not checked in this pass
